==Objectives==
Travel to Dalaran, and deliver the Sealed Nethergarde Report to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver.
* [[Sealed Nethergarde Report]]

==Description==
Well, this news certainly reinforces my assumptions, and what I have been studying. The Blasted Land's has become even more unstable, the energies within the region are beginning to grow in power.

I have been preparing a report that I need delivered to my superior's in the Kirin Tor, and I need you to deliver it at once. Communication at such a distance is impossible with the raging storms so I am relying on you.

Travel to Dalaran at once, and deliver this report to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*2650 XP
*+100 [[reputation]] with [[Dalaran (faction)|Dalaran]]

==Progress==
Yes?

==Completion==
Ahh yes, I sensed that you would be coming, I can practically feel the energy from the letter you carry.

<Upon taking the report, Ansirem Runeweaver would read with caution.>

I see.

So it is going as predicted, it would appear we may need to be more hands on to manage the growing instability within the Blasted Lands, let us hope there is no outside interferance that is causing the increased magical irregularities.
